Refund and Withdrawal Schedule
PNW’s academic schedule includes pre-set deadlines for receiving refunds on tuition and fees as well as dropping courses. Browse these key dates below.
The registration and refund deadlines in these lists are affiliated with most programs and full-term courses at PNW. If you are in a program for which these dates do not apply (e.g., RN to BSN Online, , Online MSN Nurse Executive and Nurse Educator and non-degree seeking international students), please seek communication from your program for more information.
See the Full Academic Calendar
Semester Refund Dates
Fall 2026
The refund deadlines in this list pertain to the 16-week Fall semester beginning on August 24, 2026 and ending December 19, 2026.  See the Comprehensive Schedule for Fall 2026  for other refund deadlines and last dates to withdraw.

Refund Guidelines
If you drop one or more classes during the refund period, your fees will be recalculated based on your liable credit hours.
If your recalculated total liable credit hours are in the banded tuition rate, no refund is calculated.
For more information about banded tuition and how refund amounts are calculated contact the
Bursar’s Office
.
Comprehensive Schedule
If you are registered in courses that differ from the traditional full-term dates, refer to these tables about refund percentages and the last day to drop classes that fit within the start and end dates listed.
For assistance with determining the appropriate withdrawal dates for your course(s) contact the Office of the Registrar at (219) 989-2210.
